observed_reference_runtime.source: Existing unchanged-R3 natural-session 601-pair runs on this host; not an R2 renderer or transport pilot.
observed_reference_runtime.interpretation: Lower-bound planning reference only. Renderer, deterministic materialization, hashing, geometry truth, independent validation and contention are unmeasured.

host_policy.selection_rule: Use the faster of the measured 4-worker and 8-worker profiles that preserves byte/numeric equivalence, leaves at least 8 GiB available RAM, avoids sustained paging, and meets the wall-time ceiling. The 12-worker and 16-worker profiles are outside this frozen revision and cannot be selected.
host_policy.gpu_policy: No GPU requirement is assumed. Renderer GPU use must be benchmarked and hash-equivalent before selection; RCLE R3 remains CPU.

required_preflight.input: on fixed ADVIO_14, one disjoint PREFLIGHT factorial seed complete six-arm cluster (6x602 frames) plus one disjoint PREFLIGHT guardrail seed pair (2x602 frames), all using final access mechanics; neither namespace is reused by CAL, main or formal guardrail identities
allowed_observability: CPU, RAM, GPU and VRAM utilization
forbidden_observability: quality strength tuning from any RCLE output
required_preflight.scheduling_comparison: Compare 4 and 8 workers on the same eight disjoint full-length preflight sequence identities. Each profile must run all eight identities; 12 and 16 workers are prohibited in this frozen revision because eight sequence-level atomic units cannot exercise those concurrency levels.
required_preflight.projection_rule: Project render, R3, validation, retry reserve and receipt time separately to all 496 formal sequences.
required_preflight.failure: PERFORMANCE_NOT_QUALIFIED; optimize transport, staging or scheduler and repeat only the disjoint preflight. Do not reduce main seeds, pairs or arms.

storage_budget.retention_policy: Do not retain all uncompressed frames. Deterministically render bounded arm batches, hash every transport frame, run R3, validate the arm receipt, then release only that task-owned staging batch after a cleanup receipt. Retain generator/runtime locks, scene/trajectory/frame-hash manifests, ledgers, summaries and receipts.
storage_budget.cleanup_safety: Cleanup may target only receipt-listed task staging files after hash-bound regeneration proof. It must never delete manifests, hashes, ledgers, scripts, locks, receipts or handoffs.

memory_and_process_budget.paging_policy: Sustained paging or decreasing available RAM below the floor stops new arm launches and closes the guarded run as resource failure; completed atomic arms remain resumable.
memory_and_process_budget.child_process_policy: One RCLE process per active sequence, nested native threads fixed at one, no orphan workers accepted at terminal.

canonical_host_schema_mapping.eta_seconds: projected seconds to all formal units
canonical_host_schema_mapping.last_progress_at: UTC timestamp of last completed pair or atomic receipt

progress_contract.atomic_unit: one sequence arm with 602 frame hashes, 601 ordered pair identities, ledger, summary and success receipt
progress_contract.monitoring_firewall: Progress and resource telemetry must not expose arm-level RCLE response or trigger outcomes before the full formal bundle closes.

resume_and_failure.resume_identity: Only exact completed arm receipts under the same generator, trajectory, strength, R3 transport, analysis and runtime locks may be reused.
resume_and_failure.partial_arm_policy: Delete or quarantine only the task-owned incomplete arm staging directory after resolving its absolute path and recording a failure receipt; restart that same arm from frame zero.
resume_and_failure.formal_completion: 496 of 496 atomic arm receipts valid, all frozen identities present, zero duplicates, then one independent bundle validator.
resume_and_failure.execution_incomplete: No scientific terminal until exact deterministic resume completes or the evidence version is explicitly closed incomplete.
